sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the formula-derived spindle torque constraint and the approved stress-analysis alternative with correct ship targeting, operands, formulas, tolerance handling, datatypes, and units.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The formula branch only constrains C_spex to be at least 0.3 and never computes it from EAR and Z, so arbitrary factor values pass and bladeExpandedAreaRatio is presence-only. Locate the canonical term for propeller blade count Z, require it on the ship with its canonical datatype/unit, and validate C_spex = max(0.3, 0.7*(1-((4*EAR)/Z)^3)) using tolerance scaled from that expected result. Then validate Q_sex = max(C_LE0.8, 0.8*C_TE0.8)*C_spex*F_ex with a separately expected-result-scaled tolerance. The stress-analysis alternative must also represent the directly determined maximum spindle torque using the supplied canonical maximumSpindleTorque term, not merely the presence of an approval record.

Candidate faithfully encodes the formula-derived spindle torque constraint and the approved stress-analysis alternative with correct ship targeting, operands, formulas, tolerance handling, datatypes, and units.
